snippet.title: Food Truck Empire - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Food Truck Empire's extended demo is out now!

Manage your own fast-growing food truck business in Food Truck Empire! Start with a humble burger truck and unlock delicious cuisines as you automate production and build your fleet.

Make sure to sign up for our future playtest on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1872970/Food_Truck_Empire/
